about: Modifiers worth more on a Precursor Tablet than the craft you were aiming at — hand-picked, because no price feed lists tablets. The Tablets tab shows each one's odds of turning up while you roll, with a trade search and a box for the price you see. An entry is a SET: one modifier, or several that have to be on the tablet together.

entry.mods: tablet modifier ids, all of which must be on the item at once (data/patches/0.5.0/mods.json)
entry.note: optional — why it is worth having, in the player's words
